description: Returns Keflavík International Airport (KEF) live arrivals and departures, flight statuses, gates, baggage belts, and schedule delays from Isavia / kefairport.com (max 20).

date.description: Optional flight date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in Reykjavík).

delayed_only.description: Only return flights marked delayed or shifted >= 15 min (default false).

query.description: Optional airline, flight number, airport IATA code, or city filter.

name: get_kef_flights
title: Get Keflavík Airport (KEF) Flight Board
